meta.title: Autism in Adults: Myths vs Facts

A short reel busting common myths about adult autism, highlighting social masking and a practical one‑week log to manage sensory overload. Learn the facts and a simple step‑by‑step tip.

Sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37009119/ | https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28527095/
